name: sol-advisor
description: Sol-led selective routing with a human-owned control plane, native agents, an experimental built-in Grok ACP connector, and opt-in external providers.

interface.shortDescription: Keep Sol in charge while a local console maps scenarios to native, experimental built-in, or external providers.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor keeps GPT-5.6 Sol / High in the primary session for architecture, implementation when solo or audit is selected, verification, and acceptance. Before the first task tool call, Sol declares a machine-auditable SELECTIVE ROUTE: solo is the default; delegate uses native GPT-5.6 Luna / Max for bounded work or GPT-5.6 Terra / High for higher-risk work; audit uses a fresh read-only GPT-5.6 Sol / High review; full combines one selected implementer with a fresh review only for a broad or high-risk exception. Public role metadata is authoritative and missing, conflicting, unavailable, or unobservable routing evidence fails closed. The optional control plane adds a loopback console, private scenario templates, an experimental repository-owned read-only Grok Leader + ACP connector, external-MCP descriptors such as Cursor Bridge, web/API advisory lanes, and per-provider switches without changing Sol's final authority.
defaultPrompt: Use $sol-advisor:sol-control-plane; read metadata once, resolve one scenario, and verify every auxiliary claim.
Use $sol-advisor:orchestration for the original native-only Sol Advisor workflow.
Use solo by default; external providers are optional, user-configured, and fail closed.
